PB01-H02.name: Kuroda Kanna
PB01-H02.effect:
[Grandwalker Nexus]
This Nexus can only be affected by effects that target Grandwalker Nexuses. Cores can only be placed on this Nexus via Core Charge or effects that target Grandwalker Nexuses, and cannot be moved from this Nexus except via effects that target Grandwalker Nexuses.

[Core Charge: (Vassal/Lord & Cost 3 or more)]
◆When you summon/advent a target Spirit, you can +1 core to this Nexus.
◆When this Nexus is deployed, if you do not control a Grandwalker Nexus with the same card name, you can send three cards from your decktop to the Trash. For each target card among them, +1 core to this Nexus.

[Grand Skill: 3] [LV1][LV2] Flash - (Either Attack Step)
(Once per turn, send three cores from this Nexus to the Void) You can return a "Vassal"/"Lord" family Spirit card from the Trash to your Hand. When you've done so, return an opposing Spirit/Ultimate to the Hand.

[Grand Field] [LV2] (Your End Step)
If there six cards or more in the opposing Hand, the opponent discard cards from their Hand until they only have four.

PB01-H03.name: My Sunshine
PB01-H03.effect:
[Grandwalker Nexus]
This Nexus can only be affected by effects that target Grandwalker Nexuses. Cores can only be placed on this Nexus via Core Charge or effects that target Grandwalker Nexuses, and cannot be moved from this Nexus except via effects that target Grandwalker Nexuses.

[Core Charge: (Song Bird/Imp/Imaginary Beast/Magician/Ogre Wizard) (Core Charge via Summon/Advent only once per turn)]
◆When you summon/advent a target Spirit, you can put a core from the Void onto this Nexus.
◆When this Nexus is deployed, if you do not control a Grandwalker Nexus with the same card name, you can send three cards from your decktop to the Trash. For each target card among them, put a core from the Void onto this Nexus.

[Grand Skill: 3] [LV1][LV2] Flash - (Either Attack Step)
(Once per turn, send three cores from this Nexus to the Void) Refresh a Cost 3 or less "Song Bird"/"Imp"/"Imaginary Beast"/"Magician"/"Ogre Wizard" family Spirit you control.

[Grand Field] [LV2] (Either Attack Step)
When you use a Magic card, you can return an opposing Spirit/Ultimate to the Hand.

PB01-H01.name: Shinomiya Mai
PB01-H01.effect:
[Grandwalker Nexus]
This Nexus can only be affected by effects that target Grandwalker Nexuses. Cores can only be placed on this Nexus via Core Charge or effects that target Grandwalker Nexuses, and cannot be moved from this Nexus except via effects that target Grandwalker Nexuses.

[Core Charge: (Astral Dragon/Zombie/Evil Shadow) (Core Charge via Summon/Advent only once per turn)]
◆When you summon/advent a target Spirit, you can put a core from the Void onto this Nexus.
◆When this Nexus is deployed, if you do not control a Grandwalker Nexus with the same card name, you can send three cards from your decktop to the Trash. For each target card among them, put a core from the Void onto this Nexus.

[Grand Skill: 1] [LV1][LV2] Flash - (Your Attack Step)
(Send one core from this Nexus to the Void) During this turn, give an "Astral Dragon"/"Zombie"/"Evil Shadow" family Spirit you control +5000 BP.

[Grand Field] [LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When only the opposing Spirit/Ultimate is destroyed by comparing BP with your "Wurm"-named Spirits, send an opposing Life to the Reserve.
